description: This file defines the EditEmployeeAttendanceController class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the Attendance plugin's Controller namespace. It handles pre-render logic for editing employee attendance records, including permission checks and preparing Vue component properties.

classes.name: EditEmployeeAttendanceController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling attendance editing logic, extending AbstractVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with props based on the attendance record, performs permission checks, throws exceptions if record not found or permissions denied.
